name: Bee Hotel Price Alterators
description: A clonable collection of concrete Price Alterator plugins (occupants, seasons, sliders, consecutive nights, check-in time, special nights) plus the special_night content type.
project_description: Bee Hotel Price Alterators is a clonable collection of ready-made PriceAlterator plugins for the Bee Hotel pricing chain: Occupants (per-guest surcharge), ConsecutiveNights, GlobalSlider (store-wide percentage), SpecialNights (event premiums via a special_night node type), DaysBeforeCheckin (lead-time pricing), CheckinTime (paid time slots + late-check-in fee field), OneNightOnly, SaturdayNightOnly and SundayCheckin. Each has a settings form under /admin/beehotel/pricealterator/alterators/*. The module also installs the special_night content type and a field_checkin_time field on the bee order-item type.
